== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ブラスター</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース消費し、任意の戦士に配備する。1フォース消費して起動する。運命数を引き、キャラクターなら運命数＞能力値で、ビークルなら運命数＞回避値か装甲値で命中する。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ハンソン44型ブラスター・ピストル。パワー・パックと高圧ブラスター・ガスを使い、起爆性の収束光を打ち出す。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Blaster]].

'''Lore''' — A Merr-Sonn Model 44 blaster pistol. It uses a power pack and high-pressure blaster gas to fire explosive coherent light.

'''Game text''' — Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. Use 1 Force to fire. Draw destiny. A character is hit if destiny > ability. A vehicle is hit if destiny > maneuver or armor.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore uses high-pressure blaster gas (高圧) rather than high-energy. Game text fires the weapon (起動する) instead of “may target using 1 Force”. White border, 1997 copyright.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-L-blaster-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Blaster]].</ref>
